comparison.objective: Remove a connector terminal, versus remove an interrupted suture.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab release with wire/tool pull, versus forceps knot lift, flush cutter placement, cutting, and low-contamination strand withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal removed with connector and neighbors intact; versus correctly cut and withdrawn stitch placed on gauze, instruments returned, and hands cleared.
comparison.reason: Both are extractions, but the suture task adds deformable grasp-cut-draw sequencing and clinical contamination constraints.
